Billionaires and CEOs keep preaching “work 70 hours a week,” but they’re not the ones burning out for low pay. Hustle culture glorifies overwork, convincing young people that sleepless nights and stress equal success. In reality, it’s a trap—benefiting companies, not workers.

In India, where salaries barely cover rent, this obsession with “grind” only fuels anxiety, exhaustion, and broken mental health. Productivity is sold as passion, and burnout as ambition.

In this video, we break down how hustle culture manipulates ambition—and why working smart, not endlessly, is the real win.
